title.value: RAINPROOF: An umbrella to shield text generators from Out-of-Distribution data
title.justification: The title directly references 'RAINPROOF', the main method for out-of-distribution detection presented in the paper.
title.quote: Implementing effective control mechanisms to ensure the proper functioning and security of deployed NLP models, from translation to chatbots, is essential. A key ingredient to ensure safe system behaviour is Out-Of-Distribution (OOD) detection... Our contributions include: (i) RAINPROOF a Relative informAItioN Projection OOD detection framework;...

extractions.description: The paper presents 'RAINPROOF', an OOD detection framework designed for NLP models like text generators. It emphasizes the challenges text generators face from out-of-distribution data and proposes solutions that leverage soft-probabilities in a black-box setting to improve reliability and performance. The study extensively evaluates the proposed methods against baselines, providing improvements in detecting OOD samples and aligning with task-specific performance metrics.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The central theme of the paper is developing and evaluating a framework for out-of-distribution detection in text generation applications, which is not specifically focused on climate or ecological sustainable development.
